В этом подходе, как указано на рисунке 2, при каждом шаге нейрон сfocus obа simultaneously considers itself and the previous states of other connections. Это означает, что each state represents a specific aspect of the input at that time step, allowing the network to capture relationships between elements in the sequence.

Итак, внимание — это способ simultaneous focusing on current and past elements, which enables these networks to process sequences more effectively by capturing dependencies between consecutive steps.
